description.value:
Cryptidkin Subspecies. This heritage preserves the original UUID for Jackalope (Bad Eden) while converting it from a species-root to a Cryptidkin subspecies.

“You don’t spot a Jackalope. You notice the world flinch, and then realize why.”

Jackalope. Fast because they have to be. Twitchy because the world has trained them that stillness is how you die. Half-remembered pre-Shattering folklore, half radiation-assembled rumor, and fully people.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Cryptidkin).

  • Size. Small or Medium.

  • Speed. 7 squares

  • Subspecies Lean. Your subspecies leans toward INTR (Intrigue)—expressed through Tier powers.

Core: Folklore & Frame

At creation you gain Folklore & Frame (Folklore Presence, Wasteland Adapted, Survivor’s Instinct).

Jackalope Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17). Jackalope powers emphasize: Startle Reflex (can’t-be-caught-flat burst), Wasteland Bound (long-distance run), Horns of Bad Luck (jinx aura), Can’t Catch Me (evasion), and strategic Bad Omen Runner Domain hooks.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / Bad Eden)

If you see Jackalope tracks circling your hex, you are not under attack. You are being advised.

  • Domain Edge. Your Domain gains +10 Soft Power marks and +10 Non-Lethal marks at campaign start.

  • Trail Whisper. Once per turn, your Domain can reroll a single Travel or Scout check made in a hex adjacent to your home territory.

advancement.title: Jackalope Tier I
advancement.hint: Gain your Jackalope Tier I subspecies power (maps to legacy Startle Reflex).

advancement.title: Horns of Bad Luck (Manifestation)
advancement.hint: Grant the Jackalope-only Tier I natural-weapon manifestation.
